name: Paying Debt
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of integrity and faithfulness in financial matters, particularly in paying debts. Believers are called to keep their promises and not delay repayment when they have the means, as withholding what is owed is contrary to righteousness. The borrower is reminded of their responsibility, recognizing that debt places them under the authority of the lender. Ultimately, the Bible teaches that honoring financial commitments reflects a heart aligned with God's commands and mercy.
